segments.source: Projects Using RPython
segments.translation: RPython을 사용하는 프로젝트

segments.source: A very time-dependent list of interpreters written in RPython.
segments.translation: RPython으로 작성된 인터프리터 목록입니다. 시기에 따라 내용이 크게 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Corrections welcome, this list was last curated in Nov 2016
segments.translation: 정정은 언제든 환영합니다. 이 목록은 2016년 11월에 마지막으로 정리되었습니다.

segments.source: Actively Developed:
segments.translation: 활발히 개발 중:

segments.source: PyPy, Python2 and Python3, very complete and maintained, http://pypy.org
segments.translation: PyPy, Python2 및 Python3 지원, 완성도가 매우 높고 꾸준히 유지 관리됨, http://pypy.org

segments.source: Pydgin, CPU emulation framework, supports ARM well, jitted, active development, https://github.com/cornell-brg/pydgin
segments.translation: Pydgin: ARM을 잘 지원하는 CPU 에뮬레이션 프레임워크입니다. JIT가 적용되어 있으며 활발히 개발되고 있습니다. https://github.com/cornell-brg/pydgin

segments.source: RSqueak VM, Smalltalk, core complete, JIT working, graphics etc getting there, in active development https://github.com/HPI-SWA-Lab/RSqueak
segments.translation: RSqueak VM, Smalltalk, 코어 완성, JIT 작동, 그래픽 등은 거의 완성 단계이며 활발히 개발 중입니다 https://github.com/HPI-SWA-Lab/RSqueak
issues: The meaning mostly carries over, but "그래픽 등은 거의 완성 단계" (graphics etc. are almost finished) makes the project sound further along than "getting there" (still in progress, something like "진행 중"), and ending the terse list with the full sentence "~이며 활발히 개발 중입니다" clashes with the clipped style of the rest.

segments.source: Pixie, 'A small, fast, native lisp with "magical" powers', jitted, maintained, https://github.com/pixie-lang/pixie
segments.translation: Pixie, '"마법 같은" 능력을 가진 작고 빠른 네이티브 Lisp', JIT 적용, 유지 보수 중, https://github.com/pixie-lang/pixie

segments.source: Monte, 'A dynamic language inspired by Python and E.' has an rpython implementation, in active development, https://github.com/monte-language/typhon
segments.translation: Monte('Python과 E에서 영감을 받은 동적 언어')에는 현재 활발히 개발되고 있는 RPython 구현체가 있습니다. https://github.com/monte-language/typhon

segments.source: Typhon, 'A virtual machine for Monte', in active development, https://github.com/monte-language/typhon
segments.translation: Typhon, 'Monte를 위한 가상 머신', 현재 활발히 개발 중입니다, https://github.com/monte-language/typhon
issues: The meaning is accurate, but "현재 활발히 개발 중입니다" is a full sentence ending, and it sits oddly in the middle of a comma-separated list; "활발히 개발 중" would match the source's fragment style better.

segments.source: Tulip, an untyped functional language, in language design mode, maintained, https://github.com/tulip-lang/tulip/
segments.translation: Tulip, 타입이 없는 함수형 언어, 언어 설계 단계, 유지 관리 중, https://github.com/tulip-lang/tulip/

segments.source: Pycket, a Racket implementation, proof of concept, small language core working, a lot of primitives are missing.
segments.translation: Pycket은 Racket 구현체로, 개념 증명(proof of concept) 단계입니다. 작은 언어 코어는 동작하지만 많은 프리미티브가 아직 구현되지 않았습니다.

segments.source: Slow development https://github.com/samth/pycket
segments.translation: 개발이 더디게 진행되고 있습니다. https://github.com/samth/pycket

segments.source: Lever, a dynamic language with a modifiable grammar, actively developed, https://github.com/cheery/lever
segments.translation: Lever, 문법을 수정할 수 있는 동적 언어, 활발히 개발 중, https://github.com/cheery/lever

segments.source: Complete, functioning, but inactive
segments.translation: 완성되어 정상적으로 동작하지만 비활성 상태입니다
issues: The meaning is accurate and reads naturally, but the translation turns a short English status phrase into a full sentence ending in "입니다" when a phrase like "완성되어 정상 동작하나 비활성 상태" would keep the original style.

segments.source: Converge 2, complete, last release version 2.1 in Feb 2015, http://convergepl.org/
segments.translation: Converge 2, 완료, 마지막 릴리스는 2015년 2월의 버전 2.1, http://convergepl.org/
issues: The meaning comes through and the structure matches the source, but "완료" reads like a task status. Here "complete" means a finished implementation, so "완성" or "구현 완료" would sound more natural in Korean.

segments.source: Pyrolog, Prolog, core complete, extensions missing, last commit in Nov 2015, https://hg.sr.ht/~cfbolz/Pyrolog
segments.translation: Pyrolog, Prolog, 핵심 기능 완성, 확장 기능 미구현, 마지막 커밋 2015년 11월, https://hg.sr.ht/~cfbolz/Pyrolog

segments.source: PyPy.js, compiles PyPy to Javascript via emscripten_, with a custom JIT backend that emits asm.js_ code at runtime, http://pypyjs.org
segments.translation: PyPy.js는 emscripten_\ 을 통해 PyPy를 Javascript로 컴파일하며, 런타임에 asm.js_ 코드를 생성하는 자체 JIT 백엔드를 갖추고 있습니다. http://pypyjs.org

segments.source: Inactive (last reviewed Sept 2015):
segments.translation: 비활성(마지막 검토: 2015년 9월):

segments.source: Topaz, Ruby, major functionality complete, library missing, inactive http://topazruby.com
segments.translation: Topaz, Ruby, 주요 기능 완성, 라이브러리 미비, 비활성 http://topazruby.com

segments.source: Rapydo, R, execution semantics complete, most builtins missing, inactive, http://bitbucket.org/cfbolz/rapydo
segments.translation: Rapydo, R, 실행 의미론 완성, 내장 함수 대부분 누락, 비활성, http://bitbucket.org/cfbolz/rapydo

segments.source: Hippy, PHP, proof of concept, inactive, http://morepypy.blogspot.de/2012/07/hello-everyone.html
segments.translation: Hippy, PHP, 개념 증명(proof of concept), 비활성, http://morepypy.blogspot.de/2012/07/hello-everyone.html

segments.source: Scheme, no clue about completeness, inactive, http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-scheme/
segments.translation: Scheme, 완성도 불명, 비활성, http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-scheme/

segments.source: PyGirl, Gameboy emulator, works but there is a bug somewhere, does not use JIT, unmaintained, http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-gameboy
segments.translation: PyGirl, 게임보이 에뮬레이터입니다. 작동하지만 어딘가에 버그가 있으며, JIT를 사용하지 않고, 더 이상 유지 관리되지 않습니다. http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-gameboy

segments.source: Javascript, proof of concept, inactive, http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-js
segments.translation: Javascript, 개념 증명(proof of concept), 비활성, http://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-js

segments.source: An implementation of Notch's DCPU-16, https://github.com/AlekSi/dcpu16py/tree/pypy-again
segments.translation: Notch의 DCPU-16 구현체, https://github.com/AlekSi/dcpu16py/tree/pypy-again

segments.source: Haskell, core of the language works, but not many libraries, inactive http://bitbucket.org/cfbolz/haskell-python
segments.translation: Haskell: 언어의 핵심 부분은 동작하지만 라이브러리는 많지 않으며, 현재 비활성 상태입니다. http://bitbucket.org/cfbolz/haskell-python

segments.source: IO, no clue about completeness, inactive https://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-io
segments.translation: IO, 완성도는 알 수 없으며 비활성 상태입니다 https://bitbucket.org/pypy/lang-io

segments.source: Qoppy, an implementation Qoppa, which is a scheme without special forms: https://github.com/timfel/qoppy
segments.translation: Qoppy: 특수 형식(special form)이 없는 Scheme인 Qoppa의 구현체입니다: https://github.com/timfel/qoppy

segments.source: XlispX, a toy Lisp: https://bitbucket.org/rxe/xlispx
segments.translation: XlispX, 장난감 Lisp: https://bitbucket.org/rxe/xlispx
issues: The meaning and URL are right, but "장난감 Lisp" is a very literal translation; Korean developers would more naturally say "토이 Lisp" or "간단한 실험용 Lisp 구현체".

segments.source: RPySOM, an RPython implementation of SOM (Simple Object Model) https://github.com/SOM-st/RPySOM
segments.translation: RPySOM: SOM(Simple Object Model)의 RPython 구현체 https://github.com/SOM-st/RPySOM

segments.source: SQPyte, really experimental implementation of the SQLite bytecode VM, jitted, probably inactive, https://bitbucket.org/softdevteam/sqpyte
segments.translation: SQPyte: SQLite 바이트코드 VM을 매우 실험적으로 구현한 것으로, JIT가 적용되어 있으며 현재는 활동이 없는 것으로 보입니다. https://bitbucket.org/softdevteam/sqpyte

segments.source: Icbink, an implementation of Kernel, core complete, naive, no JIT optimizations yet, on hiatus https://github.com/euccastro/icbink
segments.translation: Icbink는 Kernel 구현체로, 핵심 기능은 완성되었으나 단순한(naive) 방식으로 구현되어 있고 아직 JIT 최적화는 적용되지 않았으며 현재 개발이 중단된 상태입니다 https://github.com/euccastro/icbink
issues: The meaning comes through, but the translation turns a short list-style note into a long, formal sentence, and "개발이 중단된" loses the temporary sense of "on hiatus" (better: "일시 중단" or "휴면 상태"); the parenthetical "(naive)" also feels a bit clunky.
